2607.18100.title: Can We Break LLMs Out of Self-Loops? Fine-Grained Reasoning Control with Activation Steering
2607.18100.paper_summary: Extended reasoning has become standard for frontier Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the trajectories these models produce remain largely uncontrollable. Existing methods for shaping how a model reasons are prompt based approaches and operate at the input level, offering no fine-grained control over the reasoning process itself. Related work analyzes and discovers latent transition dynamics in the reasoning traces from Large Language Models. Building on this, we statistically characterize these states, and show that failure trajectories get stuck in self-loops, exhausting the token budget without progress toward the final answer. To intervene on these failures, We propose SOPHIA: Steering Of reasoning Processes via Hidden-state Intervention and Activations. We treat each reasoning trace as a sequence of latent states rather than an unstructured texts, and investigate whether inference time interventions can provide fine-grained control over the self-looping reasoning process. We classify every prefix to a latent state, record step level transitions, and use them to construct a bank of steering vectors indexed by state pairs. At inference time, a controller infers the current state and, given a target state, retrieves the corresponding vector and can also detect self-loops online from the transition structure to prevent the model from sinking into a reasoning black hole. Through extensive experiments, our method reliably intervenes on self-loop failures, with steering vectors that generalize to different state pairs. End task accuracy and token efficiency indicate that fine-grained controllability results in better reasoning quality.
2607.18100.paper_summary_zh: 擴展推理已成為前沿大型語言模型（LLMs）的標準，但這些模型產生的軌跡仍然在很大程度上無法控制。現有的塑造模型推理方式的方法是基於提示的方法，並在輸入層面運作，對推理過程本身沒有細緻的控制。相關研究分析並發現大型語言模型推理痕跡中的潛在轉換動態。在此基礎上，我們對這些狀態進行統計特徵描述，並顯示失敗的軌跡會陷入自我循環，耗盡令牌預算而無法向最終答案邁進。為了干預這些失敗，我們提出了SOPHIA：通過隱藏狀態干預和激活來引導推理過程。我們將每個推理痕跡視為潛在狀態的序列，而不是非結構化文本，並調查推理時間的干預是否能對自我循環的推理過程提供細緻的控制。我們將每個前綴分類為潛在狀態，記錄步驟級別的轉換，並利用這些來構建一組按狀態對索引的引導向量。在推理時，控制器推斷當前狀態，並在給定目標狀態的情況下檢索相應的向量，還可以從轉換結構中在線檢測自我循環，以防止模型陷入推理黑洞。通過大量實驗，我們的方法可靠地干預自我循環失敗，並且引導向量能夠泛化到不同的狀態對。最終任務的準確性和令牌效率表明，細緻的可控性導致了更好的推理質量。
